historical_first_three_deviation_rows_in.interpretation: The foe later follows a lane sequence different from the selected candidate. This record does not preserve the mismatch-time lane/position or selected path termination reason, so it cannot distinguish a legal alternate lane change from incomplete candidate coverage.
This is a repeated forecast for the same episode/foe encounter as the preceding row, not an independent event.

The ego's selected static path was later left, while the foe had a left-censored entry interval. Without the ego mismatch-time state and matched lane-transition evidence, the reason for deviation remains unknown.

existing_deviation_rule.decision: At each next policy-decision observation, mark side route_or_candidate_path_deviation if projected lateral distance is strictly greater than 5.0 m OR a known current lane_id is absent from the selected path lane_ids.
does_not_prove: A physically/legal lane change versus a route error
That the selected static candidate set was complete

new_passive_evidence.capture: First observed deviation per actor side on an existing next-observation snapshot; no extra prediction/calibration row and no extra TraCI read.
new_passive_evidence.missing_semantics: Unknown fields remain null or the explicit string unknown; social future routes are not queried. A missing selected candidate termination reason does not imply a dead end or a complete path.
new_passive_evidence.interval_preservation: Existing entry_intervals and clearance_intervals are copied unchanged, including a valid interval for one actor when the other actor deviates.

coverage: Strict greater-than 5 m threshold and lane-membership reason
